holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached ₹17,389 crore in September 2026, rising from ₹14,318 crore in September 2025.
Earnings call transcripts noted Q2 and H1 FY27 PAT increased by 20.1% to ₹14,843 crore.
ICICI Bank raised its fixed deposit interest rates for both senior citizens and general depositors.
ICRA and CARE reaffirmed the bank's credit ratings on October 23, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the largest fund holding at 9.69%. Although its 3-month return fell by 2.61%, strong quarterly profitability and steady credit ratings cushion its drag on overall fund performance.

watch.text: Track the appeal against the Telangana GST appellate order confirming a ₹6,95,418 penalty.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Bagchi replaced Sashidhar Jagdishan as Managing Director and CEO effective October 27, 2026.
Net profit for the September 2026 quarter came in at ₹21,537 crore on revenues of ₹95,132 crore.
Business Banking Group Head Sanjay D'Souza superannuated on October 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding an 8.97% allocation, HDFC Bank's 7.4% drop over the last 3 months detracted -0.664 percentage points from performance, making it the fund's largest negative contributor.

watch.text: Monitor share price stabilization following its fresh 52-week low and leadership transition under Anup Bagchi.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: SEBI issued a final regulatory censure order against subsidiary Axis Capital Limited on October 28, 2026.
Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached ₹7,666 crore compared to ₹5,567 crore in September 2025.
Girish Paranjpe stepped down as Independent Director on November 1, 2026.
The bank announced revisions to savings account charges effective December 1, 2026, lowering free transaction limits.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 7.97% weight, the bank provides significant exposure to Financials, and its slight 1.02% 3-month decline helped limit relative downside compared to peers like HDFC Bank.

watch.text: Observe customer transaction volume response to revised savings account charges taking effect December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI identified suspected dark-web exposure of 3,897 customer records on October 16, 2026, while stating balances were safe.
The board scheduled a meeting for November 3, 2026, to review Q2 FY27 and half-year financial results.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.59% portfolio weight, SBI's 6.38% 3-month drop detracted -0.357 percentage points, acting as another major headwind inside the 45.6% financials cluster.

watch.text: Review board approval of Q2 FY27 results and subsequent analyst discussions scheduled for November 3, 2026.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Kumar Saha was appointed MD and CEO effective January 1, 2027, and Anu Aggarwal joined senior management.
Net profit increased to ₹5,645 crore in the September 2026 quarter from ₹4,468 crore a year earlier.
The stock hit 52-week highs following an 18.27% 3-month share price rally.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kotak is the top contributor in the fund, adding +0.711 percentage points at a 3.89% weight and counterbalancing steep declines across larger banking allocations.

watch.text: Track executive handover and leadership execution under Anup Kumar Saha beginning January 1, 2027.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: TRAI imposed a ₹54.06 lakh financial disincentive, and DoT Karnataka levied a ₹2.14 lakh penalty.
The board set a meeting on November 5, 2026, to review Q2 and six-month audited results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 3.37% position in Technology, the stock advanced 12.33% over 1 month and remained essentially flat over 3 months (+0.09%), helping insulate non-financial assets.

watch.text: Examine audited Q2 and half-year numbers approved at the board meeting on November 5, 2026.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Reliance reported record Q2 FY27 PAT of ₹29,550 crore, supported by oil-to-chemicals performance.
The board authorized up to ₹15,000 crore in non-convertible debentures, and Jio Platforms completed its ₹30,188 crore IPO listing.
Fuel exports expanded to Europe and Africa to address West Asia supply disruptions.

holdings.why_it_matters: Reliance has a 2.84% weight; its 10.93% drop over 3 months dragged fund return down by -0.310 percentage points.

watch.text: Follow deployment and pricing for the approved ₹15,000 crore NCD issuance.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: October 2026 automotive sales reached 131,109 units, including record SUV sales of 73,338 units and 64,846 tractors.
Subsidiary stake in NDET decreased to 49.63%, removing its step-down subsidiary status.

holdings.why_it_matters: A 2.43% fund allocation generated a -0.399 percentage point drag over 3 months due to a 16.42% stock decline.

watch.text: Monitor passenger vehicle dispatch strength and progress on the targeted 2028 production at the ₹15,000 crore Nagpur plant.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly net profit rose to ₹7,838 crore in September 2026 from ₹7,375 crore in September 2025.
Infosys expanded its Pocharam campus in Hyderabad by 1.1 million sq. ft., adding 10,000 seats.
Canada's UNI Financial Cooperation deployed the Finacle Universal Banker system across branches.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.28% of the portfolio, Infosys added +0.111 percentage points over 3 months with a 4.86% gain, supported by a 19.2% jump in the past month.

watch.text: Track operational utilization of the new 1.1 million sq. ft. Hyderabad development center.

holdings.name: Max Financial Services Ltd

what_changed.text: Consolidated Q2 FY27 net profit reached ₹100 crore, while Axis Max Life VNB climbed 21%.
Total Value of New Business reached ₹734 crore on Annualized Premium Equivalent of ₹2,716 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Despite strong underlying VNB growth, the stock sank 19.95% over 3 months, taking -0.411 percentage points off fund returns at a 2.06% allocation.

watch.text: Observe future VNB margin preservation following broker updates and target revisions.

portfolio.statement: DSP ELSS Tax Saver Fund returned -5.81% over 3 months, pressured heavily by core private and public banking holdings.
interp: Financials make up 45.6% of the portfolio, meaning sector weakness in HDFC Bank, SBI, and Max Financial heavily dictated overall performance.
Gains from Kotak Mahindra Bank and IT holdings such as Coforge and Infosys were insufficient to counter the losses in large-cap banking and autos.
portfolio.line: Heavy banking exposure pulled 3-month fund returns down despite isolated resilience in Kotak Bank and Technology.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell 7.4% over 3 months amid leadership change, creating a -0.664 percentage point drag.
Kotak Mahindra Bank surged 18.27% over 3 months, delivering +0.711 percentage points of relief.
Max Financial dropped 19.95% over 3 months, costing the fund -0.411 percentage points.

themes.title: Private Banking Leadership Transitions
themes.text: Large leadership changes took place across major private banks, with Anup Bagchi taking over at HDFC Bank and Anup Kumar Saha appointed to lead Kotak Mahindra Bank.

themes.title: Telecom Listing and Market Dynamics
themes.text: The successful ₹30,188 crore IPO listing of Jio Platforms altered telecom competitive focus alongside Bharti Airtel.

macro.why: Disturbances prompted expanded downstream petroleum shipments to Africa and Europe.
Suspected leakage of thousands of customer records highlights heightened operational and data security risks for large retail financial institutions.

priced_in.text: Reliance's record quarterly net profit of ₹29,550 crore and the listing of Jio Platforms on October 28, 2026, are already known to the market.
Leadership succession plans at both HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank have been formally announced.

could_change.title: SBI Q2 FY27 Financial Performance
could_change.text: The board convenes on November 3, 2026, to review quarterly earnings, which could alter current public banking sentiment.

could_change.title: Airtel Q2 Audited Numbers
could_change.text: Bharti Airtel will disclose its second-quarter and half-year results following its November 5, 2026 board meeting.

portfolio.risk_note: A 45.6% portfolio allocation to Financials produces intense concentration risk, making fund performance predominantly sensitive to bank earnings, net interest margins, and regulatory actions.
